title: LLM-coupled interpretable tool wear monitoring with multi-evidence reasoning in CNC machining
abstract: arXiv:2611.34270v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interpretable tool wear assessment in CNC machining is challenging. Existing diagnostic models have high accuracy but provide limited guidance for tool replacement. This study proposes a two layer framework combining deep learning wear classification and LLM assisted reasoning. The first layer uses PCA Loading feature selection and optimized GRU to recognize three wear states, achieving 98.38 percent macro F1 score on the PHM2010 dataset. The second layer uses LLMs to generate natural language reports and replacement suggestions from classification results and feature trends. Engineer evaluation shows the reports outperform rule templates. Cross dataset tests on NASA milling data support the generalizability of this framework.

translated_title: 数控加工中基于多证据推理的大语言模型耦合可解释刀具磨损监测
translated_abstract: 数控加工中可解释的刀具磨损评估具有挑战性。现有的诊断模型虽然准确率高，但对刀具更换决策的指导有限。本研究提出了一种结合深度学习磨损分类与大语言模型辅助推理的两层框架。第一层使用PCA Loading特征选择和优化后的GRU网络识别三种磨损状态，在PHM2010数据集上实现了98.38%的宏观F1分数。第二层利用大语言模型根据分类结果和特征趋势生成自然语言报告和刀具更换建议。工程师评估表明，这些报告优于规则模板。在NASA铣削数据上的跨数据集测试验证了该框架的泛化能力。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种两层框架，将深度学习刀具磨损分类与大语言模型多证据推理相结合，在实现高精度磨损状态识别的同时，生成可解释的自然语言报告和刀具更换建议。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-layer framework coupling deep learning tool wear classification with LLM-based multi-evidence reasoning, achieving high-accuracy wear state recognition while generating interpretable natural language reports and tool replacement suggestions.
